name: Windfury Totem
description: Summons a Windfury Totem with 5 health at the feet of the caster.  The totem enchants all party members main-hand weapons with wind, if they are within 20 yards.  Each hit has a 20% chance of granting the attacker 1 extra attack with (229 * 1) extra melee attack power.  Lasts 2 min.
